title: Give notice of subscribers: company with share capital
text:
This memorandum of association pro-forma can be used to notify Companies House that each subscriber to the memorandum of association:

 • wishes to form a company under the Companies Act 2006

 • agrees to become a member of the company

 • agrees to take at least one share in the company
changeNote: Changed attachment from PDF to .odt open document format. Updated Welsh translation.
